0022600211.text: The Knicks, who are 5-4 and 3-2 at home, enter as the 10th game of their season on a three-game winning streak and sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back. The Milwaukee Bucks are 1-9 and on a six-game losing streak, and they are 15th in the East and 6 games back in the Central. Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York, while Milwaukee has Gary Trent Jr. (illness) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise), both day-to-day and also game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
